ValidationRule.description: Keeps message timing and reply positions within supported numeric ranges.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Typing_Seconds__c)), OR(Typing_Seconds__c < 0, Typing_Seconds__c > 999.9)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Pause_Seconds__c)), OR(Pause_Seconds__c < 0, Pause_Seconds__c > 999.9)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Reply_To_Step__c)), Reply_To_Step__c < 1) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Typing and pause must be 0–999.9 seconds; a reply target must be step 1 or later.
